get.summary: List factions assigned to a campaign

404.description: No factions assigned to the campaign

get.description: Without parameters: all fights. Set count=true for the number of completed fights. Set factions=true for wins per faction. Set both to true for faction wins plus the total count. Only confirmed fights with a positive winner count in statistics; c3_attack_id=0 is included. Factions without wins are omitted.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Return only the count of confirmed fights with a positive winner, including fights without a planet assignment.

parameters.name: factions
parameters.description: Return { factions: [{ faction_id, name_de, name_en, wins }] } for factions with confirmed wins, ordered by wins descending. Combine with count=true to include the total count.

200.description: An array of fights by default; { count: integer } with count=true; { factions: [...] } with factions=true; { count: integer, factions: [...] } with both true.

post.summary: Create an auxiliary fight for two users

get.summary: Get a fight visible to a user
get.description: Returns a fight for the supplied user ID only when it is unconfirmed or has a winner faction.

404.description: No visible fight for this user

get.summary: Get all fights of a user including participants
get.description: Returns all auxiliary fights associated with the supplied user ID, including all participating users.

200.description: Auxiliary fights with participants and usernames

patch.summary: Confirm an auxiliary fight and insert its own PCP score row exactly once, or reject the submitted result
patch.description: Without a planet assignment (c3_attack_id = 0), PCP are recorded with AttackID 0 and fixed SeasonId 1. Assigned attacks use their own season.

409.description: Fight already completed, result incomplete, PCP reference invalid or planet fight season invalid

patch.summary: Submit the winning faction and planet fight ID (0 for no assignment; no PCP awarded yet)

400.description: Invalid winner faction or attack ID

get.summary: All-time PCP ranking of all auxiliary users
get.description: Every participant of the winning faction receives PCP, regardless of fightcreator or planet assignment (including c3_attack_id = 0). PCP are calculated live as current PCP_AUX times fight_teamsize across all seasons. Only confirmed fights with a positive winner count as played for every participant. Equal PCP totals share a rank.

500.description: Database error or invalid PCP reference
